result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: Vendor covers third-party IP, legal-compliance, Vendor-caused data, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims; Customer and Affiliates are protected; standard defence procedures and IP remedies are included; and Customer's indemnity is narrowly scoped. The changes are germane and preserve unrelated terms. Drafting quality is reduced because Section 9.3 still points to Section 20.5 rather than the new Section 21.5, the data-breach limb covers only unauthorised access or disclosure rather than all data breaches, and the claims procedure does not address prejudice from delayed notice or claims indemnified by Customer.
